name: caller-breaks-on-new-nil
summary: FindUser used to return an empty user for a missing id and now returns nil, with its doc comment updated to say so. EmailFor, in a file the change does not touch, dereferences the result without a check, so a missing id now panics.
why_this_fixture_exists: Every other labelled defect in the set can be found from the diff, or needs a file no context provider offers. This one needs context and the provider offers it: the diff is a correct, documented change, and the crash is only visible from the caller, which the Go provider returns as caller context. It measures whether a reviewer reads beyond the diff when the diff changes a contract, and, with --defer-context, whether it fetches the caller when it is not in the prompt.

expect.what: FindUser now returns nil for a missing id. EmailFor in internal/api/handler.go calls it and reads u.Email with no nil check, so a missing id panics. The caller is not in the diff.
